title: Manufactured homes and energy-saving solutions
summary: The Entergy Arkansas Manufactured Homes Program offers a variety of energy-saving products and services to owners and residents, from faucet aerators to advanced power strips.
body_markdown:
The Entergy Arkansas[Manufactured Homes Program](https://www.entergy-arkansas.com/your_home/save_money/ee/manufactured/) offers a variety of energy-saving products and services to owners and residents, from faucet aerators to advanced power strips. Enroll today and receive weatherization upgrades, such as air sealing and duct sealing, to keep your home comfortable and energy efficient all year long.


Benefits of Home Weatherization Upgrades:


- Energy Efficiency and Comfort: Keep your home cool by sealing potential air leaks, which helps lower the cost of running your AC.
- Improved Air Quality: A well-sealed home keeps out more humidity, dust, pollen, and pests.
- Enhanced Safety: Leaky ducts can allow gases from furnaces, stoves, and water heaters to enter rooms throughout your home. Sealing leaks reduces this risk.


Start saving on energy costs today by improving the energy efficiency of your home. Visit[entergyarkansas.com/manufactured](https://www.entergy-arkansas.com/your_home/save_money/ee/manufactured/) to learn more about this program and find a participating trade ally **.**
